## Approved TenDev-only staging — October 29, 2026

Chris's **APPROVED TENDEV STAGING** authorizes only the accepted read-only adapter, two assistant migrations, secure hosted credential configuration and a narrowly capped real Terra/Qwen canary. No TenOps Pages release or operational writes. Separate Advisory context remains unavailable; this explicit Product instruction governs. **Tier 3 / focused hosted integration**, reusing the accepted local QA and 28 real isolated database groups. **Deployed to TenDev; awaiting Product acceptance.** [Evidence manifest](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tendev-staging/evidence-manifest.json), [actual canaries and limits](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tendev-staging/live-canaries.json).

### Exact release boundary and migrations

`b11b757` was verified as the direct child of accepted `d769ab3146bc8f85f282c3bbe738908223fa2532`. Its runtime is compatible by focused review, but its candidate-aware release gate remained HOLD. The entire structured-knowledge boundary was explicitly deferred, not partially overlaid. Parallel knowledge work subsequently committed `3bf04ef`, `d965c95` and `1ce2091`; its [classification verification](2026-10-29-tenbot-architecture-knowledge.md#classification-verification--october-29-2026) clears historical record drift but still retains twelve full-dev runtime/migration holds, including the excluded receival candidate. Those commits and all shared dirty work are preserved on dev. A combined release still needs exact selective runtime/migration review evidence that the knowledge gate can verify; none of its holds was bypassed.

The staged commit **`9a7c6249851fad76f72454ccd5c045dbee5ad50d`** has served baseline `ae50e0fc55a7a6d9e454016c5d73a58e792aff79` as parent and exactly 20 accepted adapter/UI/dependency/migration paths copied byte-for-byte from `d769ab3`. Inventory business UI/services, receival approval migration, unrelated changes and all b11 versions are excluded. Independent import/source review found no missing dependencies. Existing knowledge/generator bytes remain the accepted baseline. A local candidate ref retains the exact commit; no branch/worktree or Git push was made. One isolated Webpack build passed, with server-secret files excluded, only reviewed public configuration and no OpenAI key available to the build. [Boundary](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tendev-staging/boundary.json), [source plan](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tendev-staging/selected-source-plan.json).

A read-only actual shared-schema preflight passed all twelve catalog/ACL/FK/routine/collision/ledger gates on PostgreSQL 17.6 without reading private content. Only these two exact files were then applied and registered **in one atomic transaction**, with prerequisite-function preservation and default-off/zero-budget assertions:

| Shared assistant migration — applied | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `20261029220000_tenbot_openai_metering.sql` | `dccadae6768d418f52702eef82e4b221d7df3ecb46c43cc907b7f20acd450454` |
| `20261029221000_tenbot_agent_history.sql` | `47c1aeb8f96ffc33a932e6a1d3ec6f83e714c656671b15b52c892b82925d2a31` |

[Actual compatibility](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tendev-staging/shared-schema-compatibility.json), [transaction/ledger receipt](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tendev-staging/migration-application.json). `20261029210000_invoice_pending_receival_approval.sql` remains absent. No operational records, Auth users or permissions were created/changed for testing.

TenDev deployment **`845b86cf-2d17-46a0-bef4-3712e65064c5`** serves `9a7c624`; 32 public asset/Auth/CORS checks pass against exact build bytes. The shared TenBot Edge adapter is ACTIVE with JWT verification enabled, final version **13**, unchanged tested bundle SHA-256 `7517faa181df6008539576b4edd237e0e647ef65fdf80e7491a234d65c19bf9f`. Secret changes account for version increments after the initial v11 code deployment. **TenOps Pages remains `ae50e0fc`, deployment `6cda75a5-dc37-480c-8027-bd7806176c34`; Qwen routing is preserved there.** Shared backend assistant infrastructure changed under this authorization; this is not a claim that the shared backend was untouched. [Final hosted readback](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tendev-staging/final-hosted-state.json).

### Credential, authorization and real canaries

Chris privately entered the separate `TenBotHostedTerraPilot` key through Supabase Secrets and closed its editor. Its value was never viewed, copied from local experimental configuration, logged or bundled. Accepted Responses-Write metadata is reused; the verified expiry **2026-11-28T22:46:56Z** is securely configured as a server cutoff. Actual hosted authentication/model access is now proven by measured Terra responses, not key-list presence alone. The existing operator credential was used only in memory for authorized release actions.

TenDev and the Edge adapter were initially deployed with both Terra flags off and a disabled zero-budget policy. Nine real signed-browser-caller checks passed: Auth/current read capability, default-off routing, direct-history/service-loader denial, exact owner claim/release, unowned-conversation denial and clearing only a newly created synthetic conversation. Missing/invalid/anonymous JWTs return 401. Two authenticated malformed write/attachment request shapes return 400 before inference. Employee/Admin isolation, revocation and concurrency reuse exact-migration real Free-fixture results; no second real employee session or shared permission mutation is claimed.

The normal Messaging composer then passed a deliberate **Qwen fallback with OpenAI dispatch prohibited**: actual Qwen3 completion, **974 input / 136 output tokens / 8.65 estimated Neurons**, correct grounded group guidance. Three actual Terra turns passed with current verified knowledge and caller-authorized operational reads:

| Terra request | Inference steps | Accounted cost | Measured timing |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Interactive group walkthrough | 3 | $0.005515 | 11.395s first reservation → final settlement; gives only the first step. |
| Contextual next-step follow-up | 3 | $0.002528 | 12.615s on the same server measure; correctly advances to **New group**. |
| Production overview + internal test Job status/planning/material/labor | 7 | $0.012574 | **33.410s actual browser HTTP**, including 26.707s reservation → final settlement. |

The Job request used the existing internal fixture `DEV-20260803` and authorized aggregate Production metrics. It correctly distinguished saved dates from forecasts, unknown materials from readiness, zero period labor from all-time/remaining-work estimates, and missing phase/item/progress evidence. No changes were made. Hosted employee responses omit raw developer tool traces. The answer covered overview, status, planning and labor; the exact five-tool sequence was not captured. The five unchanged tool implementations/permissions and earlier QA remain the source evidence. No fresh broad per-tool matrix, invoice test or model comparison was run.

Two eligible static answers restored after a full reload/reopen with **zero additional inference**. After the live Job answer, another reload restored the same two static answers but neither the Job question nor its facts. Final stored shape remains valid, two displays and zero operational continuation/guidance. Counts remained **13 calls / three assistant turns**, all measured, no uncertain charges. Structural state checks are not semantic inspection of arbitrary prose; exclusion of live evidence also relies on the runtime eligibility boundary and this observed canary. Normal header/info disclosure/composer were verified on desktop; accepted mobile evidence is reused. No private-message/task capability, other-account impersonation or privileged operational reader was used. Private Inbox previews/screenshots were not copied into repository evidence; UI control was released.

### Bounded TenDev review window and remaining gates

Local inference was frozen: `.env.tenbot.local` retains owner-only protection with spending false, no local spender processes remained, and the 367-settled **$0.53995550** journal was reconciled conservatively as **539956 microUSD**. Synthetic fixture amounts were not imported. Only **$0.25 new shared allowance** is enabled, total inclusive fuse **789956 microUSD**, with existing per-user/request/step/rate/concurrency controls, Terra-only model and exact **TenDev-only origin**. Origin is a rollout gate, not an authorization boundary.

At **October 29, 8:35 p.m. Chicago**, new hosted usage totals **$0.020617**, shared accounted **$0.560573**, remaining allowance **$0.229383**. These costs derive from actual returned usage, pinned Standard pricing and conservative microUSD rounding; invoice/promotion-balance reconciliation is not claimed. The current hosted ledger does not retain an OpenAI token-count breakdown. Qwen token usage is recorded above. The policy expires **2026-10-30T02:22:45.717476Z — October 29, 9:22:45 p.m. Chicago**; budget exhaustion/expiry falls back to Qwen. No $4 extension, monthly $20 commitment, billing change or additional service was enabled. [Final ledger](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tendev-staging/canary-snapshot.json).

Operational checkpoints are preserved: the interrupted deployment session expired and returned Cloudflare 401 before any deploy attempt; normal credential refresh succeeded. A secret-setting POST returned an empty success body, reconciled by GET without repeating the mutation. A read-only Management RPC probe returned 400; the original error body was not retained, so its exact cause is not asserted. An explicit read-only operator transaction passed without changing application permissions. An unused masked public build flag was excluded from build input after confirming no source references; hosted Pages settings remained unchanged. None of these was an OpenAI authentication/model/spending failure.

**Ready for Product acceptance at https://tendev.pages.dev → Messaging → TenBot within the finite review window.** No observed credential, caller-authorization or metering blocker remains for this staged read-only scope. TenOps promotion still requires explicit Product acceptance/release authorization; b11 integration requires its scoped release-proof gate to clear, and any enlarged/extended pilot requires fresh ledger/credit reconciliation. All TenBot Inventory/catalog/receival writes remain disabled. No TenOps Pages deployment, receival migration, ordinary business mutation or Git push occurred. Shared dev, new knowledge commits, dirty records and existing localhost processes were preserved. Only scoped receipts/memory were added locally; stop for Product acceptance.

## Approved TenOps Terra pilot released — October 29, 2026

Chris's **TENBOT — APPROVED TENOPS TERRA PILOT RELEASE** explicitly authorizes exact `9a7c6249851fad76f72454ccd5c045dbee5ad50d`, selective publication, TenOps deployment and the finite $4 total hosted allowance including completed canaries. It excludes the uncommitted latency correction, deferred architecture knowledge and unrelated dev work. This executed receipt supersedes the prior readiness-only stop; historical receipts remain unchanged. Separate Advisory thread context is unavailable; the current explicit Product decision governs. **Status: deployed, limited read-only pilot; stop for Product review.**

### Exact release and boundaries

One Production-target build from an archive of the accepted Git object passed in **18.485s**; all archived source hashes remained unchanged. Only reviewed existing public TenOps configuration entered the build: Production branding, Planning off and Early Access off, shared Supabase public anon configuration, no local environment files or OpenAI key. The accepted tree is `c294d3314f6171a8899b11bfd5e58c9a6c843ccf`, with the same 20 selected adapter/UI/dependency/migration paths previously tested on TenDev.

- **TenOps served SHA:** `9a7c6249851fad76f72454ccd5c045dbee5ad50d`.
- **TenOps deployment:** `2019c461-3dab-422f-b750-64a17fcdcc2e`, [TenOps](https://tenops.pages.dev), [deployment](https://2019c461.tenops.pages.dev). All **32** checked served assets match the exact Production build.
- **TenDev unchanged:** `845b86cf-2d17-46a0-bef4-3712e65064c5`, same accepted SHA.
- Remote `main` and `dev` were atomically fast-forwarded from `ae50e0fc` to exact `9a7c624`; skip markers prevent a second automatic Pages build. Local dev remains `1ce2091c099baf11bcf31e5a3f57a78e88eee5f8`, with no local branch movement, whole-dev merge or worktree created.
- Shared Edge is **v15**, JWT verification on, ACTIVE, exact accepted bundle SHA-256 `7517faa181df6008539576b4edd237e0e647ef65fdf80e7491a234d65c19bf9f`. No function-source deployment was needed in this pass.

No new migrations were applied. Existing assistant metering/history ledger entries remain present and unchanged. Accepted source hashes remain `dccadae6768d418f52702eef82e4b221d7df3ecb46c43cc907b7f20acd450454` for `20261029220000_tenbot_openai_metering.sql` and `47c1aeb8f96ffc33a932e6a1d3ec6f83e714c656671b15b52c892b82925d2a31` for `20261029221000_tenbot_agent_history.sql`. The receival-write migration remains absent. **All Inventory/catalog/receival agent writes remain disabled.**

Enabled scope is natural TenOps help, interactive walkthroughs, existing verified release knowledge, five caller-authorized read-only Job tools and owner-scoped eligible conversation history. No document-to-action execution, developer experiment controls, personal ChatGPT context, model SQL or privileged operational gateway was enabled. Existing caller JWT/RBAC/RLS and current-grant checks remain authoritative. The entire deferred knowledge boundary and local latency deletion/regression remain on dev, excluded from release.

### Funding, key and rollout

Fresh existing Platform metadata showed **$6.44 available**, date-only October 31 expiration, the hosted key **Active / Responses-only**, and exact expiry **2026-11-28T22:46:56Z**. No secret value was viewed, copied or exposed. Standard-only project configuration remains. Successful actual Terra inference additionally proves current authentication/model access. No key, billing, sharing, recharge or renewal arrangement was changed.

TenOps first deployed with its origin excluded from Terra, retaining Qwen. After normal Messaging/Qwen checks, the existing shared policy was updated **once**, under its row lock, to version **3**:

| Enforced control | Value |
|---|---:|
| Total hosted allowance, including previous canaries | **$4.000000** |
| Inclusive total / UTC-month ceiling | **$4.539956**, retaining **$0.539956** imported local usage |
| Global UTC-day / employee UTC-day / request | **$4 / $0.25 / $0.25** |
| Expiration | **October 30, 2026 at 6 p.m. Chicago / 2026-10-30T23:00:00Z** |
| Other request, step, rate and open-reservation limits | Unchanged |

Prior reservation/settlement fields, carryover date/evidence and all other policy fields were compared with pre-update snapshots. No usage or uncertain reservations were erased. The fixed ceiling includes old canaries; it is not current usage plus another $4. Both TenDev and TenOps share the pool. TenOps was allowlisted with spending paused for a controlled fallback check, then the existing spending flag was restored after digest verification. Final secret digests, policy, shared bundle and Pages identities pass readback.

### Focused hosted smoke results

Tier 3 / focused Testing Level 3 release checks reuse accepted local QA, TenDev integration/security proof and all 28 real isolated database groups. No broad suite, provider benchmark, employee impersonation, permission change or business-record mutation occurred. Source/archive/artifact and financial controls received independent read-only review.

| Check | Actual result |
|---|---|
| Initial Production Qwen routing | Correct group-conversation answer; actual Qwen **975 input / 109 output tokens**, **7.832** estimated Neurons; zero OpenAI calls. |
| Terra origin enabled, paid dispatch paused | No OpenAI reservation/dispatch. Qwen attempted **976 / 81 tokens**, **6.983** estimated Neurons, but its answer was not published; correct verified guide safely displayed. The meter records Qwen outcome `failed`; exact provider/answer failure cause was not captured. This is a disclosed fallback-quality limitation, not a claim of a successful generated Qwen answer. |
| Minimal real Terra walkthrough | **PASS** — “First, open Messaging from the app header. Let me know when you’re there.” Three provider steps, **$0.005472**. |
| Authorized internal Job read | **PASS** — existing signed-in owner/Admin, only `DEV-20260803`: In Production, planned August 3–September 7, material status unknown, saved dates distinguished from forecasts, no changes. Four provider steps, **$0.006194**. |
| Static history after full reload/reopen | **PASS** — completed Terra question/answer restored; no repeat inference or repetition prompt. |
| History after live Job turn and remount | **PASS** — static answer retained, live Job question/facts absent, no history error, zero added inference. |
| Interface | Normal TenBot Messaging/header/composer; no employee-visible developer or execution controls. Existing mobile proof reused; no fresh physical-mobile claim. |

Server first-reservation to final-settlement windows were **7.805s** for the walkthrough and **12.262s** for the Job turn; these exclude entry/publication time and are not total browser HTTP latency. The uncommitted latency correction was not included. Hosted employee responses omit raw tool sequences and the current ledger does not retain OpenAI token breakdowns; provider-step counts do not establish an exact tool count. Costs use actual returned provider usage through the accepted conservative microUSD meter, not a reconciled OpenAI invoice.

New inference: **two Terra turns / seven provider steps / $0.011666**. Hosted cumulative usage: **five requests / twenty steps / $0.032283**, including accepted TenDev canaries. Final additional allowance: **$3.967717**. All OpenAI charges measured, **zero uncertain reservations**. No future promotional renewal is assumed. At expiry, exhaustion or provider unavailability, the existing Qwen/verified-guide fallback remains; already-dispatched charges retain accounting.

### Reconciled checkpoints, evidence and remaining limits

The first preflight assertion used the initial v11 Edge receipt; comparison with the final accepted v13 receipt confirmed identical source/JWT state. The policy transaction committed successfully, but Management API returned only the final SELECT while the receipt parser expected two result sets. Read-only comparison verified exact v3 fields and all prior retained reservation/settlement fields; **the mutation was not repeated**. Final Cloudflare metadata initially returned 401 because the existing OAuth access token expired at 02:10:54Z. One normal Wrangler session refresh restored read-only access; no deployment retry, new permissions or global configuration change.

[Release summary](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tenops-pilot-release/release-summary.json), [exact boundary](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tenops-pilot-release/boundary.json), [served proof](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tenops-pilot-release/served.json), [policy reconciliation](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tenops-pilot-release/policy.json), [final hosted state](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tenops-pilot-release/final-hosted-state.json), [history smoke](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tenops-pilot-release/history-smoke.json), [evidence manifest](evidence/2026-10-29-tenbot-hosted-adapter/tenops-pilot-release/evidence-manifest.json). Scratch source/build/private deployment logs remain under `/private/tmp/tenops-tenbot-hosted-adapter-20261029/tenops-pilot-release`; no private logs/configuration or screenshots were copied to evidence. No review-server port or local process was changed; UI control released.

No unresolved security, funding or deployment blocker was found for this finite read-only pilot. Remaining limits are the exact funding cutoff, occasional Qwen-to-guide degradation, bounded eligible history with no retained live Job evidence, and deliberately disabled document/catalog/receival actions. Multi-user/revocation/concurrency certification reuses accepted real database and TenDev evidence rather than new shared employee tests. Rollback removes the TenOps Terra origin or disables paid policy, preserving history/metering and applied migrations. No source feature change, unrelated dirty work, deferred knowledge gate, new framework or additional service was included. **Stop for Product review.**
